# Payment

Payment processing is documented as separate operations:

- [Create payment transaction](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/payment/create-transaction)
- [Confirm payment](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/payment/confirm-payment)
- [Get transaction status](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/payment/transaction-status)

## Notes (extraction)

- The `.html` URL serves this content. The extensionless URL redirects to a directory URL that returned HTTP 404 during verification. EN, RU and UZ agree on the operations and link targets; labels and introductory prose are translated.
